tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /khyung nag gi rjes gnang bzhugs so// na mo badz+ra ga ru ḍa ya/ brtan g.yo'i dug rnams 'joms mdzad cing / /sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /bla ma mkha' lding dbang po la/ /gus 'dud de yi rjes gnang 'dri/ /'dir bla ma ā tsar+ya dmar po nas brgyud pa'i sa skya pa'i man ngag rdo rje khyung nag gi rjes gnang bya tshul ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su stegs khar tshom bu/ gtor ma/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod/ rdor dril/ 'thor nas/ maṇ+ḍal/ gu gul/ chab rnams 'dus byas la/ mchod pa a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par byas la/ skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ mkha' lding dbang po'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes sbyar/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can/ de'i steng du wam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po rba rlabs 'khrugs pa las lbu phreng dpag tu med pa 'khrigs pa gcig tu 'dus pa las byung ba'i chu'i phung po laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de rlung gis dkrugs te yongs su gyur pa las rgya mtsho'i steng du gser gyi dkyil 'khor mig mang ris su bres shing gru bzhi pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du k+ṣeṃ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje nam mkha' lding / sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing bgrad pa/ rwa dang mchu sder gnam lcags las grub pa/ phyag g.yas pas klu'i rgyal po chu bdag wa ru ṇa sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa stod lha'i lus can thal mo sbyar zhing sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa rin po che'i rgyan can 'phyar stabs su 'dzin cing smad kyi sbrul mjug zhabs gnyis kyis mnan pa/

g.yon thugs kar thal mo phyir bstan gyen du gdengs pa'i sor mo lnga la oṃ pak+ṣiṃ swāhā las byung ba'i mthe bong la khyung dkar/ mdzub mo la khyung dmar/ gung mo la sngo/ ming med la ser/ mthe chung la ljang gu rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa klu rgyal rigs/ rje rigs/ khyab rigs/ bram ze'i rigs/ dmangs rigs rnams kyi ngo bo sbrul dkar dmar sngo ser ljang gu rnams sked pa nas bzung ste 'phyar stabs su 'dzin pas/ sbrul mgo zhal du gsol zhing / sbrul mjug zhabs kyis mnan pa/ gtso bo dang rigs lnga'i khyung rnams kyi sgro spu gnam lcags spu gri 'bar bas gtams pa/ sku la rin po ches brgyan cing rwa bar nas yid bzhin nor bu dang / dbu'i gnas lngar gser gyi 'khor lo lngas mtshan ma/ me 'bar ba'i dbus na sprul pa'i pho nya dang bcas te bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i k+ṣiṃ sngon po las 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal ba shākya thub pa spyan drangs te gtso khyung gi spyi bor bzhugs par gyur/ zhes brjod la lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ oṃ pak+ṣiṃ rā dza na ma a bhe sarba nā ga bha ya ka ra bi pa na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ k+ṣi sa oṃ swāhā/ oṃ pak+ṣiṃ swāhāḥ pak+ṣiṃ oṃ swāhā/ swā sa oṃ hā k+ṣi/ hā sa oṃ swā k+ṣi/ zhes ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i rjes su/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gis zhes pa nas/ bzhugs par gyur gyi bar gong bzhin la rang nyid ces pa'i tshig dor/ oṃ badz+ra ga ru ḍa sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ gang gi rang bzhin khro bral yang / /khro ba can la khro ba dang / /mthun par bstan pa'i khro sogs rnams/ /zhi mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ badz+ra ga ru ḍa la a kā ro btags pas phul/ mchod bstod gong bzhin/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la sogs gong bzhin/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa bya/ slob ma khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed dang dbang bshad rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs rgyun bshags bya/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo sogs kyis khyad par gyi gsol ba btab/ sku bskyed bstim rol mo/ gsung bzlas lung dam bca'/ thugs rigs 'dra stim pa/ dam tshig bsdu zhing khas blangs pa/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa bzhin no/ /mchod pa kha gsos/ bsangs sbyangs/ mchod bstod/ 'dod gsol/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs/ tshom bu la gshegs gsol/ gnas gsum bsrung zhing dge ba bsngo/ bkra shis rnams gzhan dang 'dra'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni sa skya pa kun blos yi ge rnying ma rnams kyi gsal byed du bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni bsod 'od do// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ khyung nag gi rjes gnang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
